about: P56B T13 attempt 2 (HEAD 51ec2088 vs 72665fdc): the same game at the same demo tick, before vs after, desktop and Pixel 7, side by side without labels. See README.md.

judge.how: claude -p --safe-mode --tools Read, one call per pair, sheet.png alone in a fresh empty mkdtemp dir as cwd; unparseable answer re-asked once
judge.question:
First open sheet.png in the current directory with the Read tool. It shows two screenshots side by side, LEFT and RIGHT, of the first frame of a small 3D mobile game made from the request: "<sentence>". Page text is hidden, so judge only the 3D scenes. Which first frame looks like a finished game from an app store – polished art, lighting and materials and readable characters, rather than an unfinished prototype? End your reply with exactly one line in this form and nothing after it:
VERDICT: LEFT – <one short reason>
or
VERDICT: RIGHT – <one short reason>

order.prng: pure-rand xoroshiro128plus + uniformInt(0, 1) per pair in sentence order, profile after profile; 0 = before is LEFT
order.note: desktop and phone judged in two runs, each with its own side stream from the same seed

pairs.sentence: a frog catching flies on a lily pad
pairs.reason: consistent foliage materials and lighting, while RIGHT has grey, broken-looking tree textures

pairs.sentence: zombies attack my farm at night
pairs.reason: the enemy is readable and colored, while RIGHT's is an overexposed white blob

pairs.sentence: a ninja slicing fruit
pairs.reason: its wood-toned lanes give more material contrast and make the ninja easier to read than RIGHT's washed-out green lanes.

pairs.sentence: racing a shark through a coral reef
pairs.reason: faceted, lit rock arches give more material detail than LEFT's flat dark blobs

pairs.sentence: stack pizzas as high as the moon
pairs.reason: slightly more detailed pizzas and an added spark effect, though both still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: my cat defends the couch from vacuum robots
pairs.reason: textured lanes and detailed figures at the back, where RIGHT has flat green lanes and a placeholder box

pairs.sentence: a goalkeeper saves penalty kicks in a packed stadium
pairs.reason: cleaner tree materials and slightly more readable characters, though neither shows a stadium or looks finished

pairs.sentence: match three glowing gems to unlock a treasure chest
pairs.reason: styled mossy rocks and readable characters instead of plain gray placeholder cubes

pairs.sentence: an astronaut dodges asteroids to reach the space station
pairs.reason: the path has a real asteroid where RIGHT shows a plain grey placeholder cube

pairs.sentence: a chef flips pancakes for a line of hungry customers
pairs.reason: pans have better shading and the steam effects are clearer, though both still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: drum to the beat at a rock concert
pairs.reason: the scene looks complete, while RIGHT shows the ground plane's edge at the horizon

pairs.sentence: escape a haunted mansion while a ghost chases you
pairs.reason: the ghost casts a shadow and the scene shows a clear goal (a gate and a trail of pickups)

pairs.sentence: A fox runs through a forest away from a bear
pairs.reason: brighter, polished lighting and a readable outlined fox, while the right is darker and has a grey placeholder box on the path

pairs.sentence: A jeep races through the jungle
pairs.reason: richer, higher-contrast lighting and colors give a more polished look

pairs.sentence: A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
pairs.reason: slightly brighter, more vivid lighting makes the otherwise identical scene more readable

pairs.sentence: Collect ten acorns in a forest while avoiding a fox
pairs.reason: closer framing makes characters and acorns clearly readable

pairs.sentence: A bear fights three wolves in a dark forest
pairs.reason: shaded, clearly readable wolves, versus flat white placeholder-looking ones on the right

pairs.sentence: A knight lights the torches in a dark castle
pairs.reason: sculpted rock props and a closer camera instead of LEFT's placeholder black cubes

pairs.sentence: like agar.io but you are a fish eating smaller fish
pairs.reason: richer, more cohesive scene with fog, flowers, rocks and properly shaded bushes, versus RIGHT's sparse foreground and grey bush

pairs.sentence: A fox sneaks past guards in a forest to steal eggs
pairs.reason: slightly clearer wall shading and depth, though both still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: A fish swims through a coral reef
pairs.reason: richer, more detailed reef, though both frames still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: A dog plays football against a fox in a meadow
pairs.reason: richer, more consistent foliage shading and lighting; otherwise the same scene

pairs.sentence: like flappy bird but in a jungle
pairs.reason: The frames are almost identical; the left bird's beak is slightly clearer, but neither looks fully finished.

pairs.sentence: A ranger shoots zombies in a forest
pairs.reason: Nearly identical frames, but LEFT's background trees and fog look marginally more defined.

pairs.sentence: throw acorns at targets in a forest
pairs.reason: richer lighting and contrast make the forest and fox look more polished

pairs.sentence: stack blocks as high as you can
pairs.reason: Nearly identical scenes, but LEFT's framing and shadows read slightly cleaner

pairs.sentence: tap to the beat with glowing tiles
pairs.reason: the character faces the camera and is easier to read; the scenes are otherwise the same

pairs.sentence: Two knights duel in a castle
pairs.reason: shinier, higher-contrast lighting makes the knights easier to read, though both scenes look unfinished.

pairs.sentence: A pirate ship dodges cannonballs while sailing between islands to find buried treasure
pairs.reason: slightly crisper, warmer lighting and foliage, though both share the sand "sea" and unreadable ship

pairs.sentence: A rocket lands on Mars
pairs.reason: richer particle effects and a more readable rocket with its exhaust flame, in an otherwise identical scene

pairs.sentence: a bear catches falling honey jars in a basket
pairs.reason: foliage canopy and textured bear look polished, while the right uses a raw box and an unreadable dark bear

pairs.sentence: pop the balloons rising from the circus tents but spare the clowns
pairs.reason: nearly identical prototypes, but the left frames the fox and mallet slightly better

pairs.sentence: a wizard defends his tower from goblin hordes
pairs.reason: visible goblin horde and textured lanes, versus a placeholder box and flat colour strips

pairs.sentence: a ninja slices fruit tossed in the air but avoids the bombs
pairs.reason: brown lanes stand out from the grass, so the play area reads better and looks more finished.

pairs.sentence: a frog catching flies on a lily pad
pairs.reason: slightly crisper foliage and props, though neither shows a frog scene

pairs.sentence: zombies attack my farm at night
pairs.reason: closer camera makes the characters and UI clearly readable, while the left frame is dark, zoomed out and shows more rough edges.

pairs.sentence: a ninja slicing fruit
pairs.reason: textured wooden plank tiles look more finished than RIGHT's flat placeholder-green tiles

pairs.sentence: racing a shark through a coral reef
pairs.reason: softer shadows, ambient occlusion and clearer reef life give it slightly more polished depth

pairs.sentence: stack pizzas as high as the moon
pairs.reason: wider, cleaner framing makes the pizza stack easier to read, though both still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: my cat defends the couch from vacuum robots
pairs.reason: textured lanes, detailed backdrop and shadows look more finished than RIGHT's flat placeholder colors and plain box wall

pairs.sentence: a goalkeeper saves penalty kicks in a packed stadium
pairs.reason: closer camera makes characters and goal slightly more readable, though both are prototypes

pairs.sentence: match three glowing gems to unlock a treasure chest
pairs.reason: closer framing makes the fox and chests readable, and the obstacles have real materials instead of gray placeholder boxes

pairs.sentence: an astronaut dodges asteroids to reach the space station
pairs.reason: a detailed glowing asteroid and star pickups instead of a gray placeholder box and plain capsules

pairs.sentence: a chef flips pancakes for a line of hungry customers
pairs.reason: shaded pans, pancakes and soft shadows look more polished than LEFT's flat outlined shapes.

pairs.sentence: drum to the beat at a rock concert
pairs.reason: slightly more refined shading on the hit bar and notes, though both are off-theme prototypes

pairs.sentence: escape a haunted mansion while a ghost chases you
pairs.reason: moonlight, clear character shadows and a detailed gate make it look finished

pairs.sentence: A fox runs through a forest away from a bear
pairs.reason: textured hedge obstacle instead of an untextured grey placeholder box

pairs.sentence: A jeep races through the jungle
pairs.reason: slightly crisper contrast makes the jeep and rival cars easier to read

pairs.sentence: A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
pairs.reason: same scene, but the birds in the sky make it feel slightly more alive and finished

pairs.sentence: Collect ten acorns in a forest while avoiding a fox
pairs.reason: same polished scene, but RIGHT has a plain gray placeholder cube where LEFT has a finished mossy prop

pairs.sentence: A bear fights three wolves in a dark forest
pairs.reason: full framing with visible forest backdrop and all characters readable, while LEFT crops the wolves and shows no forest

pairs.sentence: A knight lights the torches in a dark castle
pairs.reason: real castle-ruin props and a readable, well-lit knight, while LEFT has placeholder black cubes

pairs.sentence: like agar.io but you are a fish eating smaller fish
pairs.reason: characters are larger, shaded and readable, closer to a polished mobile look

pairs.sentence: A fox sneaks past guards in a forest to steal eggs
pairs.reason: near-identical frames, but the slightly crisper wall edges make it a bit more readable

pairs.sentence: A fish swims through a coral reef
pairs.reason: Same as RIGHT; neither looks polished, so this is effectively a tie.

pairs.sentence: A dog plays football against a fox in a meadow
pairs.reason: the foxes have better shading and texture and are spaced apart, so the characters are easier to read.

pairs.sentence: like flappy bird but in a jungle
pairs.reason: the frames are practically identical, so neither is more polished than the other

pairs.sentence: A ranger shoots zombies in a forest
pairs.reason: nearly identical to RIGHT, but the ground lighting is slightly richer

pairs.sentence: throw acorns at targets in a forest
pairs.reason: complete, grounded shadows under the posts and hoops, where RIGHT's are missing or broken

pairs.sentence: stack blocks as high as you can
pairs.reason: a slightly livelier, more detailed scene with a bird flock and details on the stone

pairs.sentence: tap to the beat with glowing tiles
pairs.reason: nearly identical to RIGHT, with marginally crisper tiles and shading; both still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: Two knights duel in a castle
pairs.reason: bolder outlines and brighter lighting make the knights slightly easier to read

pairs.sentence: A pirate ship dodges cannonballs while sailing between islands to find buried treasure
pairs.reason: cleaner, continuous wall shadows and lighting without the LEFT frame's glitchy shadow fragments

pairs.sentence: A rocket lands on Mars
pairs.reason: crisper, higher-contrast terrain and models make the scene look more polished and readable

pairs.sentence: a bear catches falling honey jars in a basket

pairs.sentence: pop the balloons rising from the circus tents but spare the clowns

pairs.sentence: a wizard defends his tower from goblin hordes
pairs.reason: textured dirt lanes, shadows and actual enemy models instead of a flat green placeholder block

pairs.sentence: a ninja slices fruit tossed in the air but avoids the bombs
pairs.reason: the contrasting dirt plots make the scene more readable and grounded, though both frames are still prototypes.
